asked.item: Video clip in slide 3 of carousel plays with no sound on Instagram despite baked-in voiceover

verdict.reason: S21-S23 explain that Instagram strips audio from video slides in carousels even when baked in, and say to post the video as a Reel to keep sound.

steps.text: Instagram strips the audio from video slides when you post them inside a carousel, even when the audio is baked into the video file.
This is an Instagram-side limitation, not a Blotato issue.
To keep the sound, post the video on its own as a Reel instead of inside a carousel.
